description_en: Removes authorization for a principal to access a product portfolio
kebab_example: aliyun servicecatalog disassociate-principal-from-portfolio --portfolio-id port-bp1yt7582g0000 --principal-type RamUser --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisassociatePrincipalFromPortfolio

parameters.help_en:
The RAM entity type. Valid values:

RamUser: A RAM user.

RamRole: A RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
RAM实体类型。取值：

RamRole：RAM角色
